mapper.select:
/* FunctionMapper.selectOrderList : Order function List(Detail) */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
/* ORDER_CUSTOMER */ SELECT od.HBL_NO AS hblNo ,od.MBL_NO AS mblNo ,od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO AS masterOdJobNo ,od.CONSOL_YN AS consolYn ,ad.LAST_POD_STATUS AS lastPodStatus ,det.NAME_${userLanguage} AS lastPodStatusNm
,CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSOL_YN,'N') = 'Y' AND ad.LAST_POD_STATUS >= 'ECM030' THEN 'Y' END AS chk1 ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSOL_YN,'N') = 'N' AND ad.LAST_POD_STATUS >= 'ECM030' THEN 'Y' END AS chk2
,CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSOL_YN,'N') = 'Y' THEN 'Y' END AS chk1
,od.OD_JOB_NO AS odJobNo ,ISNULL(pod.POD_JOB_NO, nPod.POD_JOB_NO) AS podCarryIn ,ISNULL(pod1.POD_JOB_NO, nPod1.POD_JOB_NO) AS podRpt ,ISNULL(pod2.POD_JOB_NO, nPod2.POD_JOB_NO) AS podSendHold ,od.CUSTOMS_ID_TYPE AS customsIdType ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC AS consigneeNameLoc ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME AS consigneeName
,CONCAT(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS consigneeAddress ,od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC AS consigneeAddressLoc ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM AS commodityItem ,od.BOUND as bound ,od.BOUND_TYPE as boundType
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) AS consigneeHp ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) AS consigneeTel ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CUSTOMS_ID_ENC, 1) AS customsId
,od.CONSIGNEE_HP AS consigneeHp ,od.CONSIGNEE_TEL AS consigneeTel ,od.CUSTOMS_ID AS customsId
,od.ECM_BUY_TYPE AS ecmBuyType ,od.AGENT_REG_NO AS agentRegNo ,od.FORWARD_AGENT_CODE AS forwardAgentCode ,od.SALES_BROKER_REG_NO AS salesBrokerRegNo ,od.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE as consigneeZipcode ,od.ORDER_NAME as orderName ,od.ECM_YN as ecmYn FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON od.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det ON od.ENT_CODE = det.ENT_CODE AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND ad.LAST_POD_STATUS = det.CODE LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_POD pod ON od.OD_JOB_NO = pod.OD_JOB_NO AND pod.POD_STATUS = 'ECM030' LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_POD pod1 ON od.OD_JOB_NO = pod1.OD_JOB_NO AND pod1.POD_STATUS = 'ECM010' LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_POD pod2 ON od.OD_JOB_NO = pod2.OD_JOB_NO AND pod2.POD_STATUS = 'ECM040' LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_POD_01 nPod ON od.OD_JOB_NO = nPod.OD_JOB_NO AND nPod.POD_STATUS = 'ECM030' LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_POD_01 nPod1 ON od.OD_JOB_NO = nPod1.OD_JOB_NO AND nPod1.POD_STATUS = 'ECM010' LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_POD_01 nPod2 ON od.OD_JOB_NO = nPod2.OD_JOB_NO AND nPod2.POD_STATUS = 'ECM040'
LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_MULTI multi ON multi.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
AND od.CONSOL_YN = 'Y'
/* FHL */ SELECT od.HBL_NO AS hblNo ,od.MBL_NO AS mblNo ,od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO AS masterOdJobNo ,od.CONSOL_YN AS consolYn ,det.NAME_${userLanguage} AS lastPodStatusNm
,CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSOL_YN,'N') = 'Y' AND odAdd.LAST_POD_STATUS >= 'ECM030' THEN 'Y' END AS chk1 ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSOL_YN,'N') = 'N' AND odAdd.LAST_POD_STATUS >= 'ECM030' THEN 'Y' END AS chk2
,CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSOL_YN,'N') = 'Y' THEN 'Y' END AS chk1
,od.OD_JOB_NO AS odJobNo ,ISNULL(pod.POD_JOB_NO, nPod.POD_JOB_NO) AS podCarryIn ,ISNULL(pod1.POD_JOB_NO, nPod1.POD_JOB_NO) AS podRpt ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC AS consigneeNameLoc ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME AS consigneeName
,CONCAT(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS consigneeAddress ,od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC AS consigneeAddressLoc ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM AS commodityItem ,od.CUSTOMS_ID_TYPE AS customsIdType
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) AS consigneeHp ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) AS consigneeTel ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CUSTOMS_ID_ENC, 1) AS customsId
,od.CONSIGNEE_HP AS consigneeHp ,od.CONSIGNEE_TEL AS consigneeTel ,od.CUSTOMS_ID AS customsId
,od.ECM_BUY_TYPE AS ecmBuyType ,od.AGENT_REG_NO AS agentRegNo ,od.FORWARD_AGENT_CODE AS forwardAgentCode ,od.SALES_BROKER_REG_NO AS salesBrokerRegNo ,od.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE as consigneeZipcode ,od.ORDER_NAME as orderName ,od.ECM_YN as ecmYn FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD master ON master.OD_JOB_NO = od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL odAdd ON master.OD_JOB_NO = odAdd.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det ON od.ENT_CODE = det.ENT_CODE AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND odAdd.LAST_POD_STATUS = det.CODE LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_POD pod ON od.OD_JOB_NO = pod.OD_JOB_NO AND pod.POD_STATUS = 'ECM030' LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_POD pod1 ON od.OD_JOB_NO = pod1.OD_JOB_NO AND pod1.POD_STATUS = 'ECM010' LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_POD_01 nPod ON od.OD_JOB_NO = nPod.OD_JOB_NO AND nPod.POD_STATUS = 'ECM030' LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_POD_01 nPod1 ON od.OD_JOB_NO = nPod1.OD_JOB_NO AND nPod1.POD_STATUS = 'ECM010'
WHERE (
(od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{item.odJobNo} AND ISNULL(ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO, '') = ISNULL(CAST(#{item.simpleDocNo} AS VARCHAR(20)), ''))
)
WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO IN (
#{item.odJobNo}
)
AND od.ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
/* CONSOL > 개통부 검증때만 사용*/ SELECT od.HBL_NO AS hblNo ,od.MBL_NO AS mblNo ,od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO AS masterOdJobNo ,od.OD_JOB_NO AS odJobNo ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC AS consigneeNameLoc ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME AS consigneeName ,od.CUSTOMS_ID_TYPE AS customsIdType
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) AS consigneeHp ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) AS consigneeTel ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CUSTOMS_ID_ENC, 1) AS customsId
,od.CONSIGNEE_HP AS consigneeHp ,od.CONSIGNEE_TEL AS consigneeTel ,od.CUSTOMS_ID AS customsId
FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD mod ON mod.OD_JOB_NO = od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item.odJobNo})
AND od.CONSOL_YN = 'Y'
AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' AND (ad.LAST_POD_STATUS != 'ECM040' OR ad.LAST_POD_STATUS IS NULL)
mapper.insert:
/* FunctionMapper.updateSendHold : 오더 발송보류적용 */ UPDATE TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL SET LAST_POD_STATUS = 'ECM040'
WHERE OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item.odJobNo}) AND ISNULL(LAST_POD_STATUS,'') < 'ECM040'

/* FunctionMapper.updateLastPodStatus2 : LAST_POD_STATUS 업데이트 */ UPDATE ad SET LAST_POD_STATUS = pod.POD_STATUS
FROM TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TOP 1 A.OD_JOB_NO, A.POD_STATUS, A.POD_DATE, A.POD_TIME FROM( SELECT #{odJobNo} AS OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = (SELECT MASTER_OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}) AND POD_STATUS IN ('ECM060','ECM070') UNION ALL SELECT #{odJobNo} AS OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_01 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = (SELECT MASTER_OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}) AND POD_STATUS IN ('ECM060','ECM070') UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND POD_STATUS NOT IN ('ECM060','ECM070') UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_01 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND POD_STATUS NOT IN ('ECM060','ECM070') UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_02 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_03 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND POD_STATUS IN ('ECM400', 'ECM420') ) A ORDER BY A.POD_STATUS DESC ) pod ON pod.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO WHERE ad.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
mapper.select:
/* FunctionMapper.selectOrderFunctionChk : 오더 수정전체크 */ SELECT od.HBL_NO AS hblNo FROM TB_ECM_OD od WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item.odJobNo})
AND od.CONSOL_YN = 'Y'

/* FunctionMapper.selectOrderListEnt : 오더 입항일자 적용대상조회 */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SELECT A.* FROM( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO AS odJobNo ,od.HBL_NO AS hblNo ,od.MBL_NO AS mblNo ,od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO AS masterOdJobNo ,od.BOUND AS bound ,od.BOUND_TYPE AS boundType ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC AS consigneeNameLoc ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME AS consigneeName ,CONCAT(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS consigneeAddress ,od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC AS consigneeAddressLoc ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM AS commodityItem ,od.HSN AS hsn ,od.CUSTOMS_ID_TYPE AS customsIdType
,CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSOL_YN,'N') = 'Y' THEN 'Y' END AS chk1 ,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM( SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM040' UNION ALL SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_01 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM040' ) A ) AS podSendHold
,CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSOL_YN,'N') = 'Y' AND ad.LAST_POD_STATUS >= 'ECM030' THEN 'Y' END AS chk1 ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSOL_YN,'N') = 'N' AND ad.LAST_POD_STATUS >= 'ECM030' THEN 'Y' END AS chk2 ,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM(
SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM030'
SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM005'
UNION ALL
SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_01 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM030'
SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_01 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM005'
) A ) AS podCarryIn ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND CODE = ad.LAST_POD_STATUS) AS lastPodStatusNm
,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM(
SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM050'
SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM007'
UNION ALL
SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_01 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM050'
SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_01 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM007'
) A ) AS podCarryout
,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM(
SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM010'
SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM003'
UNION ALL
SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_01 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM010'
SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_01 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM003'
) A ) AS podRpt
,(SELECT TOP 1 ABNORMAL_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO ORDER BY REGISTER_DATE_TIME DESC) AS ABNORMAL_CODE
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) AS consigneeHp ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) AS consigneeTel ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CUSTOMS_ID_ENC, 1) AS customsId
,od.CONSIGNEE_HP AS consigneeHp ,od.CONSIGNEE_TEL AS consigneeTel ,od.CUSTOMS_ID AS customsId
,od.ECM_BUY_TYPE AS ecmBuyType ,AGENT_REG_NO AS agentRegNo ,FORWARD_AGENT_CODE AS forwardAgentCode ,SALES_BROKER_REG_NO AS salesBrokerName ,CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE as consigneeZipcode ,ORDER_NAME as orderName ,ECM_YN as ecmYn FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item.odJobNo})
WHERE od.HBL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(#{hblNo}))
WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{modJobNo}
WHERE 1 = 0
AND od.CUST_CODE_LV${ecmCustomerLevel} = #{ecmCustomerCode}
AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = #{blTypeMh}
WHERE 1 = 0
AND od.CONSOL_YN = 'Y'
) A
WHERE ABNORMAL_CODE IS NOT NULL

/* FunctionMapper.selectPenaltyOrderList : Order List(Detail) */
SELECT A.* ,COUNT(A.OD_JOB_NO) OVER() AS SUM_COUNT FROM ( SELECT ad.LAST_POD_STATUS ,od.CUST_CODE_LV1 AS AGENT_CODE ,od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.PO_DATE ,od.PO_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.MBL_NO ,od.HSN ,od.SHIPPER_CODE ,od.SHIPPER_NAME ,od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS ,od.SHIPPER_TEL ,od.CONSIGNEE_CODE ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME ,od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS ,od.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID ,od.CD_TYPE ,od.ECM_TYPE ,od.CURRENCY_CODE ,od.EXCHANGE_RATE ,od.AMOUNT_CUR ,od.AMOUNT_LOC ,od.AMOUNT_USD ,od.PIECES_REAL ,od.PIECES ,od.GWT ,od.CBM ,od.GWT_LBS ,od.VWT AS DIM_VOLUMN ,ad.PRINT_YN ,ad.PRINT_DATE ,od.ORIG_CODE ,od.ORIG_COUNTRY ,od.OB_DATE ,od.AR_DATE ,od.VESSEL_FLIGHT ,od.FTA_YN ,od.FTA_REMARKS ,ad.CUSTOMS_ID_VERIFY ,ad.CUSTOMS_ID_ERROR ,od.INSPECTION_YN ,ad.SE_INSPECTION_YN ,ad.DROP_YN ,ad.XRAY_YN ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM ,od.BOUND ,od.BOUND_TYPE ,od.CONSOL_YN ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC ,od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC , CASE PENALTY_YN WHEN 'A' THEN '상호' WHEN 'B' THEN '영문주소' WHEN 'C' THEN '한글주소' WHEN 'D' THEN '품명' WHEN 'AD' THEN '영문상호, 품명' WHEN 'BD' THEN '영문주소, 품명' WHEN 'CD' THEN '한글주소, 품명' END + '이(가) 세관기준에 맞지 않아 과태료 대상입니다.' AS PENALTY_REASON
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CUSTOMS_ID_ENC, 1) AS CUSTOMS_ID
,od.CONSIGNEE_TEL ,od.CUSTOMS_ID
FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON od.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det ON od.ENT_CODE = det.ENT_CODE AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND ad.LAST_POD_STATUS = det.CODE
AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' AND PENALTY_YN != 'N' )A

/* FunctionMapper.selectOrderRegistrationList : 거래정보 등록항목 조회 */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SELECT od.HBL_NO AS hblNo ,od.MBL_NO AS mblNo ,od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO AS masterOdJobNo ,od.CONSOL_YN AS consolYn ,ad.LAST_POD_STATUS AS lastPodStatus ,det.NAME_${userLanguage} AS lastPodStatusNm ,od.OD_JOB_NO AS odJobNo ,od.CUSTOMS_ID_TYPE AS customsIdType ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC AS consigneeNameLoc ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME AS consigneeName ,CONCAT(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS consigneeAddress ,od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC AS consigneeAddressLoc ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM AS commodityItem ,od.BOUND as bound ,od.BOUND_TYPE as boundType ,od.CONSIGNEE_HP AS consigneeHp ,od.CONSIGNEE_TEL AS consigneeTel ,od.CUSTOMS_ID AS customsId ,od.ECM_GOV_SEND_YN AS ecmGovSendYn FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON od.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_EDI_GOV_ECOMMERCE gov ON ad.EC_IF_SBMT_NO = gov.EC_IF_SBMT_NO LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det ON od.ENT_CODE = det.ENT_CODE AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND ad.LAST_POD_STATUS = det.CODE
mapper.insert: /* FunctionMapper.updateOdLastStatus : 오더 등록 취소 */ UPDATE ad SET ad.LAST_POD_STATUS = 'ECM002' , ad.LAST_POD_DATE = od.REGISTER_DATE_TIME FROM TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD od ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE ad.OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item.odJobNo}) AND ISNULL(LAST_POD_STATUS,'') = 'ECM003'
mapper.select: /* FunctionMapper.selectCustomsRessiuItemList : 개인통관부호 인증번호 재발급 오더 아이템 조회 */ SELECT MAX(OD_JOB_NO) AS odJobNo, MAX(ORDER_NO) AS orderNo FROM TB_ECM_OD_ITEM WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} GROUP BY ISNULL(ORDER_NO,'')
